frequency_question: How often do major bipartisan energy permitting reform bills pass both houses and get signed into law within a single two-year congress?
membership_rule: Includes major omnibus energy or infrastructure permitting reform packages explicitly targeting cross-state transmission or pipelines that reached serious floor debate or bipartisan negotiation stages. Excludes routine appropriations, narrow single-sector riders, and non-energy infrastructure bills.
